svg.aria-label: toolmenu session output: tools inserted mid-list, a description edited, each pinned to the step that caused it

g.text: $ npx toolmenu session --scenario examples/unlock.scenario.yml -- node test/fixtures/session-server.mjs
toolmenu session examples/unlock.scenario.yml
session-fixture 1.0.0 · protocol 2026-07-28 · stdio
baseline: 5 tools · ~290 tokens (estimate) · listening for list_changed: yes
fresh-process check: the same menu
step 1: list · no change
step 2: call search_forms {"query":"onboarding"} · no change
step 3: call unlock_toolset {"toolset":"audits"} · menu changed · list_changed received · scope:
per-process
ERROR session/mid-insert
+2 tools inserted at position 1 (list_team_audits, get_team_audit). Invalidates the cached
prompt: the tool list and the conversation after it are processed again.
the change starts at position 1; any change to the tool list invalidates the cached prompt,
so the whole tool list (this server's part: ~406 tokens, estimate) and the conversation after
it are processed again
WARN session/side-effect
Steps 3, 4, 5: A freshly started server doesn't show this change. On stdio every connection is
its own process, so toolmenu can't tell a per-connection change from a global one. On
2026-07-28 the tool set MUST NOT change as a side effect of requests on the connection.
step 4: call unlock_toolset {"toolset":"reports"} · menu changed · list_changed received · scope:
per-process
WARN session/append
+1 tool appended at the end of the list (export_report). The end of the tool list isn't the end
of the prompt: most clients send tools first (Claude's Messages API does), so any change to
them, an append too, invalidates the cached conversation after them. Appends are cache-safe
only if your client adds new tools after the cached content, as tool search (deferred loading)
does.
~54 new tokens (estimate)
step 5: call touch_descriptions · menu changed · list_changed received · scope: per-process
ERROR session/edit
get_form: description changed mid-session.
the change starts at position 3; any change to the tool list invalidates the cached prompt,
so the whole tool list (this server's part: ~469 tokens, estimate) and the conversation after
it are processed again
step 6: list · no change
step 7: call delete_form {"form_id":"f_1","dry_run":true} · refused · not marked readOnlyHint
ERROR session/refused
Refused to call delete_form: it isn't marked readOnlyHint, and session calls tools for real.
Set "allow_writes: true" in the scenario if that's intended.
final: 8 tools · ~469 tokens (estimate)
3 errors, 2 warnings, 0 info
